dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Good morning, and thank you for coming to the interview.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good morning. Thank you for inviting me.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Please tell me a little about yourself and your experience.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I studied business, and I have worked in marketing for three years.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Interesting. Why did you apply for this position?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I like your company's projects, and I want to learn in a bigger team.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: What would you say is your greatest strength?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I am organized, and I stay calm when there is pressure.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Do you prefer working alone or as part of a team?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I enjoy both, but I do my best work in a team.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Good. We will contact you next week. Do you have any questions?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, could you tell me about the salary and the working hours?
